name: Modernist
description: Flat, architectural, set entirely in Archivo. Near-mono light blue on cream, a visible modular grid, zero corner radius, crisp 1px rules.
direction: Modular grid layouts: equal-width cells, strong horizontal and vertical rhythm, visible structure.
1px dividers between major sections — thin, but ink and never softened away.
Button labels flush left, never centered.
Photography prints in pure black and white through .grayscale.

color.note: accent-2 is a machine-derived stand-in kept only so both sets resolve; treat it as the same role as accent.
color.accentNote: The accent role points at step 400, not the usual 500: the brief asks for a light blue and 500 (L 0.588) reads as a mid blue. Because the fill is light, accentContrast is the ink — white on it is about 2:1. On the dark steps (600-900) text goes back to the surface colour.

contrast.accentOnGround: at least 3:1 — icons, large text and interface chrome only
contrast.textOnAccentFill: the ink (accentContrast); on ramp steps 600-900 use the surface colour instead

shadowNote: The hard offset follows the rule weight: it shrank with the borders so a card does not read heavier than its own frame.

states.hover: one tint from the accent ramp (--color-accent-100 on a light ground)
states.pressed: one step past the base — with the base at 400 that is 500 on hover and 600 when pressed
states.focusVisible: var(--focus-width) solid var(--color-accent), outline-offset 2px — kept thicker than a rule so it never reads as a border

components: btn (primary, secondary, ghost, danger, icon, block, sm)
field + label, input, radio, seg + seg-opt
shell (brand, topbar, side, main), crumbs, dropzone, pagination, login
